data.gender_notes: Melitta is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Melitta was a goddess associated with bees and honey. Her name derives from the Greek word 'meli' meaning 'honey'. Melitta is a symbol of sweetness, creativity, and hard work. The name Melitta carries the meaning “Honey bee, sweet one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Melitta usually hope their child will grow to embody honey bee, sweet one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name evoking the sweetness and productivity of a hive.
data.etymology: Melitta belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Honey bee, sweet one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Melitta total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
